# Support

If you need help with P1S-GCODE, open an issue in this repository.

## Before opening an issue

- Read `README.md`
- Search existing issues
- Include printer/firmware context

## What to include

- Printer model and firmware
- G-code snippet or file context
- Expected vs actual behavior
- Steps to reproduce
- Logs/pictures (if available)

## Security reports

Do not open public issues for security problems.
Use `.github/SECURITY.md`.
